first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public georeferenced physical building-footprint Polygon coordinates for the University of Exeter Forum (building 3, Streatham Campus), with explicit building type/use evidence bound to the same record. The official University Streatham Campus map visibly maps Forum and lists it under Academic, Administration and Social buildings, but the selected PDF exposes only a cartographic building shape and grid reference 6G, not machine-readable georeferenced polygon coordinates or a feature geometry payload; therefore no individual building record was accepted.
